issues.title: Centralised command for parrallel running tasks
issues.body:
### Feature Description

When Multiple tasks running in sync or async mode. 
Given current scenario they are runnig in sync mode. 
User should be able to provide prompt that becomes basic for all queues tasks.I had 6 queued tasks and i had provided prompt to ignore test cases as well as implementation check to fast track code changes and manual testing but next task ignored it and i had to provide this prompt for every tasks.

### Use Case

Queued tasks should have context of previous user prompt's for tasks execution.
